title: AEGIS
body:
Capital preservation research
Quantum-X · Serendib University Endowment
USD 10 million proposed mandate
notes: Introduce the mandate and identify this as an AI-assisted proposal pending independent team review. The objective is a defensible loss budget, not the highest backtested return.

title: The investment decision
body:
ADJUST the mandate before funding
Resolve stress tolerance and the spending objective
notes: The final brief asks for a decision. Explain that low daily volatility alone does not justify accepting the mandate. A 15% proposed drawdown limit conflicts with the replay evidence.

title: A conservative policy framework
body:
10+ year horizon · provisional 4% nominal objective
AGG 35–70% · gold 5–20% · equities 20–50%
No leverage; daily rebalancing is a research assumption
notes: The 4% objective assumes 2.5% inflation, about 1.46% real growth before spending. No client payout rate was supplied. Constraints are our proposed assumptions for human review, not confirmed instructions.

title: Data before decisions
body:
5,470 aligned adjusted closes · seven eligible ETFs
Training through 2018 · development 2019–2022
Test 2023-01-03 to 2026-09-30
notes: Sources: approved Yahoo through yfinance and FRED DTB3. No missing returned aligned cells. Flags are retained. Rates are strictly lagged but current vintage. This is a retrospective chronological experiment, not a preregistered live record. See documentation/Sources.md.

title: The proposed allocation
body:
Training variance minimization
The AGG cap binds; bond concentration remains a risk
notes: Explain sample covariance with 10% diagonal shrinkage, the constraints, and why zero international/energy weights are allowed. Geographic diversification was not forced. These weights need team review.

title: Return is one part of suitability
body:
AEGIS net held-out CAGR 9.99%
Annual volatility 6.64% · drawdown 6.12%
notes: Compare all alternatives without choosing the best test outcome. Costs are 10bp per dollar of absolute daily turnover. Benchmark uses the same net accounting. Income adequacy remains untested.

title: Risk estimates depend on assumptions
body:
One-day 99% losses on the same portfolio
Gaussian agreement does not establish tail adequacy
notes: Historical quantiles retain observed extremes. Parametric normal portfolio log returns and Monte Carlo normal asset log returns aggregate differently; both omit heavy tails. Dollar amounts use constant $10m NAV.

title: EVT makes uncertainty visible
body:
90% threshold · 76 exceedances
Shape -0.189; uncertainty spans zero
Tail laboratory exposes threshold sensitivity
notes: Threshold was fixed before the test to provide around 76 exceedances in 756 observations. Explain the GPD excess model, minimum 40 count, ES unavailable for shape at least one, and why a negative point estimate is not a safe loss bound. Source: McNeil/Frey context and SciPy, documentation/Sources.md.

title: Forecasts precede observed losses
body:
756 prior observations for every date
Legacy Basel traffic lights use exactly 250 days at 99%
notes: Kupiec tests frequency and Christoffersen tests first-order clustering. Non-rejection is not proof. Last 250 is explicitly separate from the full test. Sources: Kupiec 1995, Christoffersen 1998 and BIS 1996, documentation/Sources.md.

title: Crisis losses challenge the risk budget
body:
Terminal return can conceal a deeper interim drawdown
Historical replay is hindsight exposure, not a live track record
notes: Replay actual returns through 2008, COVID and 2022. Contrast terminal return with peak drawdown. The simultaneous funding squeeze is explicitly assumed, with no probability or invented recovery.

title: Useful innovation includes rejection
body:
Volatility-state score difference +0.132
95% interval [-0.111, +0.394]
No reliable improvement; retain historical baseline
notes: Negative FZ0 difference would favour the extension. Its confidence interval crosses zero and its exception clustering is rejected. Demonstrate the evidence ledger, threshold lab, crisis controls and separate policy checks. The deterministic assistant uses no external LLM.

title: Conditions for a fundable mandate
body:
Agree crisis tolerance and payout requirement
Validate an eligible allocation and feasible rebalancing
Human team reviews, revises and signs the decision
notes: Conclude with ADJUST. If 15% remains binding, require substantiated reallocation or reject this candidate. Limits can be exceeded in the future. No approval, GitHub publication or deployment is fabricated. The team must own and defend the final judgment under brief section 8.7.
